{{Quote|Lord Vader! The ship's information retrieval system has been wiped clean!|stormtrooper commander|<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Information retrieval systems''' were computers which allowed individuals to retrieve stored information.

==History==
To prevent the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from discovering that the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] had been carrying the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]], the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} on-board information retrieval system was wiped clean before the Imperial forces boarded the vessel.<ref name="ANH Novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>
